appraisal_events.evidence: les Verdurin ayant avancé leur retour, Odette était à Paris depuis midi; elle n'avait pas eu l'idée de l'en prévenir; ne sachant que faire, elle avait été passer sa soirée seule au théâtre et il y avait longtemps qu'elle était rentrée se coucher et dormait.
appraisal_events.explanation: In the closing sentence the narration steps outside Swann's anxious perspective to report plainly that Odette returned early and felt no need to tell him, spending the evening indifferently while he kept an anxious, sleepless vigil for her.

status_effects.explanation: Her casual failure to inform Swann of her return, and her unconcerned evening at the theater while he waits up all night, locally cast her as careless toward him.

ambiguities: The alias-map hit for 'Saint-Loup' is the place name 'Saint-Loup-de-Naud' (a town Swann is asked to guide visitors to), not an appearance of the character Robert de Saint-Loup; he is not materially present in this passage and was not scored.

Odette's controlling behavior ('cela ferait un effet déplorable', forbidding Swann's travel) is presented largely through Swann's own jealous interior monologue rather than as narrator-endorsed fact; only the final paragraph's report of her indifferent return is treated here as reliable narration, so a stronger reading of her diminishment was avoided.
